summary.headline: SIMMTECH issues KRW 150bn private convertible bond w/ warrants (12th series)
summary.what_happened: SIMMTECH Co., Ltd. resolved on Nov 26, 2026 to issue its 12th series of non-guaranteed, non-separable, private perpetual bonds with warrants, totaling KRW 150bn. The bonds carry a 3.0% coupon and mature on Dec 4, 2056, with proceeds designated for facility funds, and warrants exercisable into 1,409,906 common shares at KRW 106,390 per share.
summary.why_it_matters: Convertible and warrant-linked bond issues can dilute existing shareholders if the warrants are exercised, since new shares increase the total share count. Such filings also typically set out repayment, early redemption and interest-deferral terms that determine the issuer's future cash obligations.
